name: Jug-eum-ui Sigan
source:
The dead came out of their graves and attacked innocent people! Some were terrified, and some tried not to believe. Joseon Kingdom was immersed in a strange incident that it had never seen before.

"There's definitely a cause for all this..."
translation:
死者从坟墓中走出来，袭击无辜的人！有些人感到害怕，有些人不敢相信。朝鲜王国陷入了前所未有的怪事之中。

“这一切肯定是有原因的……”
